analysis.explanation: Section 4 requires screening to complete before any release; the only exception is a capped manual-screening pilot that does not waive screening. Whether screening completes before release decides which route is available.
analysis.business_effect: If screening completes first, Harbor can run a full release. If not, Harbor is limited to a ten-account manual-screening pilot and must defer the wider rollout.

tests.title: Sequencing obligation under Section 4
tests.summary: The operator must complete screening before releasing a payment; Section 5 requires a dated screening record.
tests.exceptions: Limited pilot of at most ten test accounts may use manual screening; the exception does not waive screening.
tests.applicability: Harbor is the operator that releases payments under the fictional supplier contract, so Section 4's sequencing obligation applies to it.

conditions.question: Does screening complete before release?
conditions.assessment_basis: Product has not confirmed whether screening completes before release; recorded as an open supporting question and an open fact.

options.title: Delayed full release (screening completes first)
options.consequence: Harbor may release payments through the normal path, satisfying Section 4's sequencing requirement.
options.trade_off: Release is delayed until screening finishes, pushing back launch timing.
options.recommendation_reason: This is the only route that permits a full (uncapped) release under the contract.

options.title: Limited pilot (manual screening, at most ten test accounts)
options.condition_summary: Screening cannot be confirmed to complete before a full release
options.consequence: Harbor may proceed only with a limited pilot of at most ten test accounts using manual screening; the wider rollout must wait.
options.trade_off: Capped at ten accounts and still requires screening (manual); does not authorize a wider rollout.
options.recommendation_reason: This is the only contract-compliant path when screening timing is unconfirmed.

options.title: Treat the pilot as the first release and defer the wider rollout
options.condition_summary: Business choice independent of the timing fact
options.consequence: Harbor stays within the contract while gathering data, deferring the wider rollout until screening timing is confirmed and pilot operational work is complete.
options.trade_off: Smaller initial footprint and slower scale-up.
options.recommendation_reason: Preserves learning and contract compliance while limiting first-release exposure.
